options: A `.git` folder with Git's internal data
questions.explanation: `git init` initializes a repository in the current folder by creating the `.git` folder that holds Git's internal data.

options: copy an existing remote repository to your machine
questions.explanation: `git clone` copies an existing remote repository (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) to your local machine.

questions.prompt: Which of these does `git status` NOT show?
questions.explanation: `git status` shows modified, staged and untracked files and the branch name. History is `git log`.

options: settings that only affect the editor
questions.explanation: They are not login credentials; Git stores them as author information in every commit.
